title: Add one bounded manual status filter to canonical Command Work Queue six-view browser
goal: Allow an authorized analyst to filter existing Command Incident/Task work items by one exact host-owned status without changing route, Shared Saved Views ownership or object permissions.
invariants: Exactly six immutable canonical system views, one GET /command/work-queue route; status is optional literal query, not another route, workflow or Saved View.
Reuse first-party Project and Owner.CanRead per Incident/Task BEFORE any status filter, with current host SessionResolver tenant/environment/principal on every GET.
Status filter is exact 0..64 UTF-8 bytes with no control chars or wildcard, stable priority unchanged, bounded <=5000 owner candidates and <=50 displayed authorized rows.
HTML navigation to six views retains current permitted status filter with URL encoding; accessible GET form stays same route; no scripts/inline styles.
Default JSON and HTML when no filter selected are backward-compatible; Shared owns persisted/permission-aware Saved Views.
security_properties: Reject unknown/duplicated/oversized/untrusted HTTP filters before querying owner; tenant/principal/environment never client-controlled.
Run owner object ACL checks before status matching so inaccessible items cannot be inferred through projection counts or HTML.
HTML uses html/template escaped content and URL-encoded navigation; no-store, nosniff, frame denied, CSP default-src none and form-action self only for read-only GET.
Provider/revoked/session failure returns no partial rows or source IDs.

migration.rationale: Additive opt-in literal read-only filter on already existing first-party Command route

rollback.strategy: Revert status filter fields and HTML GET form, leaving six-view read-only projection and JSON route intact
verification: Original six system views still render and no filter is required
No Shared view state is stored

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 full 27-section contract including manual filtering, exact Command six-view catalogue and Shared mechanism boundary
Existing E10-CMD-101C-HTML native browser and E10-CMD-101B-HTTP single host-authorized route
Current Host SessionResolver/Owner and deterministic Work Queue Project sorting
outputs: Literal status filter after authorization for each owner-resolved Incident/Task on all six views
Accessible status GET form and encoded six view links retaining filter with no new endpoint
No-filter JSON remains unchanged; filtered JSON states exact current status_filter, no unauthorized data
acceptance_tests: Authorized Incident/Task status exact projection, including empty/no-authorized-items and original no-filter semantics
Every owner object still receives current CanRead before filtering; foreign tenant ID never enters access checks; denied matching status leaks no data
HTTP accepts bounded optional status, refuses duplicate/oversize/control/invalid UTF-8 and client tenant/owner injection, no rows on denied session or source failure
HTML form/filter/navigation on same route for all six keys with safe URL encoding and owner-controlled XSS payload escaped

Exact-head Linux/macOS/Windows Go runtime + mandatory engineering-kernel checks, risk-proportionate security coverage >=90 changed scope unchanged; independent L2 on material status-filter boundary if published stable

performance_budget.rationale: No new owner queries or extra sort; one literal comparison only AFTER existing first-party owner ACL; <=5000 candidates and <=50 rows remain
metrics: No additional Owner.CanRead calls versus original one per in-scope candidate
No new persistent data, index, network or background worker

definition_of_ready: E10-CMD-101C-HTML is IMPLEMENTED, exact-head mandatory engineering and runtime CI success and L2 one-shot already executed without accessible verdict
Canonical CAP-CMD-101 explicitly requires Class-0 manual filtering and status is already a first-party projected Incident/Task field
No final Shared Saved View schema, mutation, IAM or incident detail ownership decision required for this narrow literal filter
definition_of_done: One coherent child PR with actual manual same-route filter and current owner authorization, exact-head Go+Node multiOS and engineering required CI
One independent targeted READ-ONLY L2 on stable SHA for new query/HTML display boundary, no duplicate parent L2
Remain IMPLEMENTED not full CAP ACCEPTED, and do not merge until parents/CI/native approvals succeed
